title: Lixity — The Offline Manuscript & Research Workspace
description: Precise text metrics, historical research matching, and version comparison. Your manuscripts stay private on your local drive.
headline:
One workspace.
Your perspective.
intro: Find the passage that changes a chapter’s rhythm. Follow a scene detail back to its source. Share a reading copy with the background your readers need. Lixity brings close reading, research and language analysis into one local manuscript workspace.
demo_note: Fictional English manuscript. Read-only demo. No account or upload.
preview: The real workspace: read the manuscript, then choose when to inspect its patterns.
read_title: Develop the text. Return to the passage.
read_text: Read without analysis marks, find a passage and leave work markers. The unreleased editor adds writing, undo and local autosave; switch to reading the saved revision without losing editor history.
research_title: Keep the source behind the scene.
research_text: Connect a manuscript quotation to sources, dossiers and author decisions. Retained versions let you revisit the evidence behind a detail, even when a source or your interpretation changes.
share_text: Prepare a PDF, a review workspace or a reading copy with selected background notes. Your source project stays yours.
principle_text: Use patterns to ask better questions about a text. Counts describe the supplied material; heuristics need context. Lixity does not grade literary quality, prove authorship or rewrite your prose.
start_text: Install Lixity locally on Windows, macOS or Linux. Start with Markdown or plain text and follow the installation guide.
scope: This website follows the development checkout. Check the published release for available features; optional services have separate data boundaries.
languages_text: Explore this website in seven languages. The app follows the selected analysis profile; CLI report language has its own setting. Technical documentation stays in English.
limits: Analysis resources and validation differ by language; German and English have the broadest coverage. Interface translation does not translate your manuscript.
feedback_text: Tell us what you were trying to write, investigate or share, and where the workflow helped or interrupted you. You do not need to share your manuscript.
linguistics_title: See what makes a chapter different.
linguistics_text: Compare sentence rhythm, vocabulary and readability across chapters. Open the counted words and sentences behind a measurement, then return to the passage. Export JSON with explicit settings for repeatable linguistic analysis.
language_suggestion: Prefer another language? Use your saved choice or a language supported by your browser.
tour_note: Silent recording · Light and dark views · Fictional English manuscript
tour_read: Read first. The manuscript stays centre.
tour_passage: One passage: exact sentences and word counts.
tour_research: Research beside the text: dossiers and claims.
tour_context: Every quotation keeps its source version.
tour_return: Back to reading, with the passage kept.
tour_error: The video could not load. Explore the interactive demo instead.
editor_status: Writing in Lixity: the integrated editor is implemented in the development checkout, not yet released. The tour and public demo show the read-only workflow.
workflow: Close reading, evidence and chapter comparisons stay connected to the text. Built-in analysis runs offline; optional speech and research services are configured separately. The CLI and Python API reuse the same analysis engine.
